messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] bym
parts:
its better to use the 'bym2' model instead of 'bym', as it has a better
parametersation. see the paper

author = {A. Riebler and S. H. S{\o}rbye and D. Simpson and H.
Rue},
title = {An intuitive {B}ayesian spatial model for disease
mapping that accounts for scaling},
journal = {Statistical Methods in Medical Research},
keywords = {year2016,my.own,my.cv},
year = 2016,
volume = {25},
number = {4},
pages = {1145-1165}
}


I think there is some code with that paper, otherwise, you can also
check the book by Paula Moraga, or the one by Virgilio (please check r-
inla.org and the book section)
